class.name: BulletSpeedData2D
class.description: One bullet's movement: current speed, cap, and acceleration. Put one entry per bullet in [BulletVolleyData2D.all_bullet_speed_data] — entry [code]i[/code] drives bullet [code]i[/code] only. Use [method generate_random_data] to roll a batch with ranges. Negative [member speed] is legal and flies backwards along the heading (velocity = direction × speed); the tick clamps symmetrically to [-max_speed, max_speed] when max_speed is above 0, so reverse flight survives. Example: speed -250 with max_speed 1000 → the bullet retreats at 250 px/s. NaN/Inf values are rejected — that bullet reads 0/0/0 and its siblings are untouched.

method.name: generate_random_data
method.description: Generates random speed data: amount_to_generate entries with each value rolled inside its MIN/MAX range. Requires amount_to_generate above 0 and every MIN at or below its MAX, otherwise returns empty.

members.member: Change of the speed in px/s per second (negative slows down, and keeps going into negative speeds, which fly backwards). The speed stops growing at [member max_speed] in either direction; with [member max_speed] 0 it has no limit and holds its last finite value instead of overflowing.
Top speed in px/s for [member acceleration]: the speed is clamped to the range from -max_speed to max_speed. 0 (the default) means no top speed.
Starting speed in px/s along the bullet's direction.
